---
title: "Summary video views"
format: html
---

```{r}
# Load packages
library(readr)
library(tidyverse)
# Load data
video_views <- read_csv("C:/Users/irisk/OneDrive - Tilburg University/Data prep. Programming Skills/TikTok-project-2026-2027---group-10/data/raw/video_view.csv")
# Overall summary
video_views %>%
  summarise(
    total_impressions = sum(impressions_n, na.rm = TRUE),
    avg_watch_rate = mean(watch_rate, na.rm = TRUE),
    n_videos = n()
  )
# Video summary  
Video_summary <-video_views %>%
group_by(video_id) %>%
summarise(
watched = sum(watched_n, na.rm = TRUE),
impressions= sum(impressions_n,na.rm= TRUE),
watch_rate_avg= mean(watch_rate, na.rm= TRUE),
watch_share_avg = mean(avg_watch_share, na.rm = TRUE)
) %>%
arrange(desc(impressions))
Video_summary
# Top 10 most viewed videos
video_views %>%
   arrange(desc(watched_n)) %>%
   select(video_id, watched_n)%>%
    head(10)
```
